description: This file is a unit test class for the LeavePeriodService in the OrangeHRM leave management plugin. It contains test methods for various functionalities of the LeavePeriodService, including retrieving months and dates, handling leave period data, and related configurations.

classes.name: LeavePeriodServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeavePeriodService functionalities in the OrangeHRM leave management plugin.

methods.name: testGetListOfMonths
methods.description: Tests that the method getListOfMonths returns all months correctly in order.

methods.name: testGetListOfDates
methods.description: Tests getListOfDates method for correctness across different months and leap year considerations.

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodDao
methods.description: Verifies that getLeavePeriodDao returns an instance of LeavePeriodDao.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodStartDateAndMonth
methods.description: Checks the retrieval and caching behavior of current leave period start date and month.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodWhenNotDefined
methods.description: Ensures that null is returned when leave period is not defined.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Tests retrieving the current leave period when it is defined.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Checks the normalized output of the current leave period.

methods.name: testGetMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDateWhenLeavePeriodNotDefined
methods.description: Verifies behavior when leave period is not set, expecting null.

methods.name: testGetMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Data-driven test for calculating the maximum allowed leave period end date based on various parameters.
